resources.string: Back up your setup to your own WebDAV
Backups are end-to-end encrypted with your sync password, so the storage provider cannot read them. On a new or another device, pick a backup to restore hosts, networks, fingerprints and preferences.
No backups yet. Tap \"Upload this device\'s setup\" to create one.
Enter a valid address starting with https://
If your provider offers app passwords, use one here
Backups are stored in this folder. It is created if missing.
Leave blank to keep the current one

The sync password encrypts your backups, and restoring on another device needs the same password. If you forget it, backups encrypted with it cannot be restored. Changing it only affects later uploads.
Only the server details and sync password saved on this device are removed. Backups on WebDAV are not affected.
Invalid address: it must start with https://

Adds or updates what is in the backup and keeps what only this device has.
Makes the selected items match the backup exactly. Items that exist only on this device are removed.
